actionType.description: Action type used to decide behavior and default label: dislike = feedback action, detail = navigate to href, askEd = dispatch ask-ed with question.

href.description: Optional target URL used by the detail action.

question.description: Optional preset question used by the askEd action.

variant.description: Optional visual style variant: primary = filled accent button, secondary = outlined neutral button. Defaults to primary for askEd and secondary for other action types.

items.description: One action button configuration in the notification footer.

actions.description: Ordered button actions rendered in the footer.

description: Props for the notification button list component.
